```sh
kafka share-group delete <groupIds...>
```

Delete one or more share groups

## Arguments

| Argument      | Description               |
| ------------- | ------------------------- |
| `groupIds...` | share group ids to delete |

Shared options and defaults: [connection profiles, JSON output, logging and help](../../../global-options/).

## Defaults

Deletes the selected share groups; topic data is separate.

## Before you run

Removes share-group state. Stop members first and plan how a recreated group should resume delivery.

## Flags

| Flag                 | Description                                        |
| -------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `--brokers <string>` | comma-separated broker list, e.g. localhost:9092   |
| `--yes`              | confirm the deletion without an interactive prompt |

## Examples

```sh
kafka share-group delete orders-readers --brokers localhost:9092 --yes
```

## Output

Illustrative, abbreviated output. Empty arrays show the result envelope; actual entries, identifiers, optional fields and broker errors depend on the request and cluster.

With `--json`:

```json
{
  "results": [
    {
      "groupId": "demo-share",
      "ok": true
    }
  ]
}
```

Declared exit codes: `0`, `1`, `2`, `4`, `5`. See the exit-code reference for meanings.
